thinking-lab.description: Co-founding an independent software company that builds HealthERP and custom systems for ambitious businesses.
thinking-lab.longDescription: Thinking Lab is a small independent software company based in Sylhet. I'm one of three people on the founding team — spanning industry and academia — building dependable digital systems and products of our own. Our first product is HealthERP, a hospital management system meant to connect the clinical, administrative, and financial work that keeps a hospital moving.
responsibilities: Co-founded the company with a three-person team across academia and industry
Building HealthERP, a hospital operations system covering patients, appointments, pharmacy, billing, laboratory, and administration
Helping shape product, engineering, and delivery for custom business software
Staying close to messy real-world workflows instead of shipping generic dashboards
achievements: Launched thinkinglab.info and positioned HealthERP as the founding product
Helping define a senior, hands-on engineering and delivery practice from day one

ponno.description: Founded an AI sales agent for Facebook-first merchants: a dashboard for products and orders, plus a RAG chatbot that sells on Messenger.
ponno.longDescription: Ponno started from a simple observation: a lot of Bangladeshi commerce still happens on Facebook pages, and shop owners spend their evenings answering the same product questions. I founded the company, hired and mentored two engineers, and built an MVP that lets merchants manage a catalog while an AI agent handles product queries and order-taking in Messenger.
responsibilities: Built and managed a team of 2 engineers, ran code reviews, and mentored for on-time deliveries
Shipped a React/Next.js dashboard for merchants to create businesses and manage products and orders
Built a RAG-powered Facebook Messenger chatbot with tool-calling and vector search for product queries and order placement
Led customer development, finalized the feature set, ran demos, and gathered 10+ early leads to test product-market fit
achievements: Took an AI sales agent from idea to a working Messenger-integrated MVP
Validated early demand with 10+ merchant leads from live demos
Built and mentored a two-engineer team through on-time deliveries

ramble.description: Building Ramble — an AI product for searching your network, transcribing meetings, and turning conversations into something you can actually follow up on.
ramble.longDescription: At Ramble I work on a private network-intelligence product: dossiers for people you know, RAG over your own data, meeting transcription, and follow-ups that don't fall through. The work sits at the uncomfortable intersection of LLMs, real-time collaboration, and a product that has to feel trustworthy with very personal information.
responsibilities: Built a conversational platform so people can search and engage with contacts using RAG and LLMs
Developed document-based conversations and summary generation with Python tooling across multiple model providers
Designed and implemented a rich text editor with commenting, mentioning, and highlighting, plus real-time multi-user sync via PlateJS and PubNub
Built and tested the web app with Next.js, TypeScript, and Playwright
Shipped voice-powered note taking, commitment extraction, and follow-up workflows from meetings
achievements: Turned a meeting-notes idea into a searchable who-knows-what network product
Shipped real-time collaborative editing with multi-user synchronization
Built RAG-powered contact search over private relationship data

edgep-instructor.description: Taught Python and data science to 100+ students at three universities, as an industry expert on a World Bank-backed ICT Division program.
edgep-instructor.longDescription: As an industry expert for EDGE (ICT Division of Bangladesh, World Bank-backed), I taught Python programming and machine learning to undergraduate students at Shahjalal University of Science and Technology, Jagannath University, and Stamford University Bangladesh — including in the same classroom where I attended my first programming class.
responsibilities: Delivered lectures on Python fundamentals including pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn
Taught machine learning concepts including regression, clustering, and classification
Demonstrated how to build small user interfaces with Flask
Taught more than 100 undergraduate students across three universities
achievements: Taught 100+ students at three major universities in Bangladesh
Contributed to a government-backed digital skills initiative
Covered both programming fundamentals and applied ML in one curriculum

traders-connect.description: Built native Swift modules, a reusable React Native component library, and a 20+ screen mobile app for a large-scale trading platform.
traders-connect.longDescription: On contract I helped stand up the mobile and front-end foundation for an upcoming large-scale trading platform — native Swift talking to gRPC, a reusable React Native design system, and a full app with more than 20 screens.
responsibilities: Wrote native Swift modules to connect a React Native app to a gRPC server
Built a reusable React Native component library with styled-components
Engineered a cross-platform mobile app with over 20 screens
Implemented OAuth for authentication in the React Native app
Helped lay down the foundational front-end infrastructure for the web product
achievements: Shipped a 20+ screen mobile application
Created a reusable cross-platform component library
Integrated native Swift modules with React Native over gRPC
Implemented secure OAuth authentication

recruit.description: Built AI-assisted resume tooling, test suites, and auth for Re:cruit's early product before the work evolved into Ramble.
recruit.longDescription: Re:cruit is where I started with this team. I built a full-stack resume product with Next.js, PostgreSQL, and OpenAI, wrote Playwright and Jest suites, and helped with authentication and internal data tools. That work later grew into Ramble.
responsibilities: Built a resume-building application with Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, and PostgreSQL, using OpenAI for content generation
Designed comprehensive test suites with Jest and Playwright for Next.js apps
Implemented authentication with Magic Link
Built Python tools for language-corpus testing and data analysis
achievements: Shipped an AI-enhanced resume builder used as a core early product
Put real end-to-end coverage around a Next.js application
Laid groundwork that later became Ramble

kaz-software.description: Led design and development of complex React apps — including a 40+ page dual-UI product, a React 18 upgrade, and a Single-SPA micro-frontend merge.
kaz-software.longDescription: At Kaz Software I worked on large React applications: designing dozens of pages, migrating React 16 to 18, merging four apps into a Single-SPA micro-frontend, and adding Cypress coverage. A lot of the boring-but-important work that makes a product actually shippable.
responsibilities: Led the design of over 40 pages for a complex web application with two distinct UIs, using React, TypeScript, SWR, Redux Toolkit, RSuite, and SCSS
Upgraded two web applications from React 16 to React 18
Merged four separate React applications into a unified micro-frontend with Single-SPA
Containerized applications with Docker to improve deployment
Wrote end-to-end tests with Cypress
achievements: Designed and implemented 40+ pages for a dual-interface product
Led React 16 to 18 migrations
Consolidated four apps into one micro-frontend platform
Added Cypress end-to-end coverage

bengali-ai.description: Built web apps for Bengali language technology, including a TTS model benchmarking dashboard wired to Python models over WebSocket.
bengali-ai.longDescription: At Bengali.AI I helped put Bengali speech and language models in front of people. I built a React benchmarking app for Bengali text-to-speech models and a Flask/WebSocket layer so the models could talk to the browser in something close to real time.
responsibilities: Developed a React application for benchmarking Bengali text-to-speech models
Created a Python Flask wrapper to connect machine-learning models to the web app over WebSocket
achievements: Shipped a benchmarking platform for Bengali TTS models
Integrated ML models with a web UI over WebSocket
Contributed to Bengali language technology in the open
